kind.description: M9's dispatchable intake kinds — see config/paste-intake-routes.json's m9.kinds. Every other AGENTS.md Paste Intake row is deferred for this milestone and must classify as "other" (needsUser: true) instead.

statusTo.description: For kind:"status-update" only — the target status, in track-outcomes' canonical vocabulary (e.g. rejected, offer, withdrawn, interview).

proposedAction.description: Short human sentence for the confirm card, e.g. "Evaluate this posting against your gate." May reference the deterministically-computed trackerMatch summary given as prompt context, but must never invent a match itself.

needsUser.description: true when the paste is ambiguous, unreadable, or matches a kind this milestone hasn't wired a dispatch lane for yet (see config/paste-intake-routes.json's m9.status:"deferred" rows).
